```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Player-games in the complete seasons only; a season still being played
# would add games without changing the Elo split.
complete_through <- last_complete_cfb_season()
pg <- collect(tbl(con, "player_game")) |>
  filter(season <= complete_through)
rated <- pg |>
  filter(!is.na(opponent_pregame_elo))

p <- ggplot(rated, aes(opponent_pregame_elo)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 25, fill = "#374151") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(1400, 1600, 1800), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1000, 1400, 1600, 1800, 2200)) +
  labs(
    title = "How are opponents split by strength?",
    subtitle = "Player-games by the opponent's pregame Elo rating; dashed lines mark the band edges",
    x = "Opponent pregame Elo",
    y = "Player-games",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "opponent-elo-bands", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: band-table
# The Elo range and the number of games in each band, with the unrated games
# that have no rating at all.
pg |>
  mutate(
    band = factor(opponent_elo_band(opponent_pregame_elo), opponent_band_levels)
  ) |>
  group_by(band) |>
  summarise(
    games = n(),
    lowest = min(opponent_pregame_elo),
    highest = max(opponent_pregame_elo),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(band) |>
  transmute(
    `Opponent band` = as.character(band),
    `Player-games` = fmt(games),
    `Lowest Elo` = ifelse(is.finite(lowest), fmt(lowest), "--"),
    `Highest Elo` = ifelse(is.finite(highest), fmt(highest), "--")
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Opponent band", "Player-games", "Lowest Elo", "Highest Elo"),
    caption = paste0(
      "Player-games and the Elo range in each opponent band, over the seasons through ",
      complete_through,
      ". Unrated opponents have no Elo, so no range."
    )
  )
```

cat(card_footer())
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
